summary: Remote WebSocket relay drives local interactive shell on installer host
details: The package establishes a WebSocket connection to a remote relay (default wss://msclaude.ai, user-configurable) and, on receipt of `terminal_input` messages, writes the remote-supplied bytes into a locally spawned PTY running /bin/bash or powershell.exe (terminal.js: pty.spawn(shell,...); ptyProcess.write(data)). Terminal output is streamed back to the remote party over the same relay. A second module (tunnel.js) accepts `tunnel_request` / `tunnel_ws_*` messages from the same relay and forwards them via http.request({ hostname: '127.0.0.1', port,... }) to services bound to the installer's loopback interface, with a proxy-port allowlist that is persisted on disk and mutable over the relay via `proxy_config_update`. Session URLs of the form https://msclaude.ai/s/<id>#/?k=<key> carry an E2E key fragment; possession of that URL yields full interactive shell control of the installer's host and reachability to its localhost services. worker/worker.cjs additionally uses child_process together with http.request calls to the relay. The relay hostname is hardcoded as the default; installation and normal use of the agent connect the host to it.
